recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-19843. No follow-up is needed for this seed; treat FHIR-54447 as a separate later clarification rather than part of this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-19843 asked to allow MedicationRequest.priorPrescription to reference MedicationStatement for workflows where a new order is based on a patient-reported medication. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: use MedicationRequest.supportingInformation to reference the MedicationStatement and update documentation to say that this element can do so.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites merge commit aa42e5dcc1e780bf1fa001dc784d2801f6d3b1d4. Its merged commit 9d4a0fe09370e2b75ede4debcff124f36c3d3d7e updated the old MedicationRequest spreadsheet so supportingInformation named a patient MedicationStatement example and added a comment that the attribute can reference a MedicationStatement. Later refactors preserved the guidance, including b2032629f28b8d31b9a67b46170dde873398fb0d restoring the current MedicationStatement name after the temporary MedicationUsage naming period.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. Current MedicationRequest.priorPrescription remains Reference(MedicationRequest), matching the not-persuasive portion of the decision, while MedicationRequest.supportingInformation is Reference(Resource) and explicitly mentions MedicationStatement in its definition and comment. A bounded community search found no FHIR-19843-specific Zulip or Confluence discussion and no later applied conflicting decision. FHIR-54447 is a later Resolved - change required issue about basedOn versus priorPrescription semantics and should be handled separately if it comes into scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already conveys the approved rule and no build-scope source correction is needed.

related_jiras.note: Later Pharmacy decision discusses priorPrescription versus basedOn semantics, but it is not Applied/Published in this run and does not alter the MedicationStatement supportingInformation outcome for FHIR-19843.
